title: Mall convenience store?
content: I've dreamt many, many times about a service station somewhere in a rural area. Sometimes it's in/around the woods. Other times it is the lone building sitting on what I could only describe as a tarmac that stretches far out into the distance. Sometimes I work there, other times I'm just there, just hanging out/looking around. It's also never normal daylight/daytime. It's almost always night time, and when it's not it's barely still dusk/twilight. Anyone else dream of this place?
